feature_contract.goal: Prevent GOAL progress 0–99% titles, elapsed-time glyphs and result sprites from inheriting a newer queue epoch when an original SpriteNode pointer is recycled before D3DX physical eye submission.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R84 native queued ScreenHud GOAL/result progress and delayed D3DX GPU batch provenance. Preserve +TIME independent flush, 6th/6 and vehicle rank, F11/ESC, original world/SkyGlow, R26_SAFE, input/FFB, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original 0x4973C0/0x4974E0 GOAL text and result progress native sprite producer registers exact GOAL ScreenHud tag.
hooks_uiscaling.cpp BeforeQueueNode preserves outgoing D3DX batch before SelectSpriteQueueNode increments native queue epoch even when next node pointer is reused.
R84 R33 and R30 consume physical queue node, queue epoch, source WVP and producer identity for actual LEFT and RIGHT GPU submissions before OpenXR host composition.
subcomponents: Reopen physical queue transition for same-address GOAL SpriteNode reuse while preserving the old exact producer and per-eye queue epoch.
Compile-time positive/negative tests for recycled and different GOAL nodes, unknown/mixed/fallback and unrelated +TIME, world and overlay producers.
Maintain R84 original native End fallback when no exact live homogeneous batch is eligible, with no change to original race input/FFB/SkyGlow.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Original GOAL progress sprites and 0x4B9200-family result text can submit multiple SpriteNodes under one source token, with D3DX Draw→Flush delayed relative to native producer.
source_trace: Original GOAL native producer assigns exact ScreenHud and GoalTime/ResultProgress token to SpriteNode.
Native BeforeQueueNode calls CanIsolateD3DXGoalQueueNodeTransition while still using the outgoing exact node/epoch.
SelectSpriteQueueNode unconditionally increments queue epoch, even when same physical pointer is recycled.
Original predicate excluded identical outgoing/incoming node pointers, leaving a physical batch unflushed across the new R84 eye identity.
alternatives_rejected: Do not widen all ScreenOverlay2D or globally Flush unknown D3DX batches; do not change GOAL timer, +TIME, native input, original SkyGlow or R26_SAFE.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only homogeneous exact GOAL ScreenHud D3DX batches flush under their previous SpriteNode/epoch before the next queue selection; matching eye GPU submissions still undergo conservative R84 per-eye validation.
diagnosis.root_cause: GOAL queue node transition predicate requires outgoingNode != incomingNode despite a guaranteed queue-epoch increment for every selection, allowing an old deferred batch to inherit the newly selected GOAL queue epoch in pointer-reuse cases.
